title: Pydantic AI: Tool Integration
description: Tool decorator with type hints and docstring generates schema; tool appears as description and result in context window.

steps.description: Tool integration: days_between tool, agent with instructions, and invoke.
Imports: datetime, Agent, and common helpers.
Agent: Agent with make_model, instructions to use tools for date arithmetic, capabilities with watch.
Tool: @agent.tool_plain decorator, days_between with type hints and docstring for schema generation.
Execution: run_sync with date question, print output, show_context to see tool in window.
